balls.text: length ball on middle and off. Swiped to deep midwicket, and Starc has only conceded six off his final over.
slower ball outside off, quite full. Axar swings at it and drags it towards deep backward square leg
tried to make room to hit through the off side. Starc banged it in a touch shorter and he toe-ended it towards third man
another wide and full ball. Gurkeerat tries to make room and hit over cover, only manages a thick edge that Karthik takes well. Makes it look simple, but good footwork to move quickly to his right
another low full-toss, a bit of width too, and he can't beat cover with a firmly struck drive
slower low full-toss outside off, drives but can't beat cover
sees Gurkeerat shaping to step down the track and bowls a back-of-a-length ball just outside off. He manages to poke it away towards deep point
bowled. Bailey moved a long way across to try and lap-sweep, and Chahal beats him with a quicker one and hits his leg stump
out of his crease again, makes room this time, and lifts the off-stump ball down the ground, to the left of long-off, who manages to run around and field it
down the track comes Bailey, clips against the turn to deep midwicket
sees Axar coming down the track and bowls it straighter and a bit shorter. It turns in sharply and goes off Axar's pad into the off side, as he misses the flick
tossed up, angled across, and Axar gets down on one knee to fetch it from outside off and clear the boundary wide of long-on, to the left of the chasing Kohli
full outside off, and Bailey slog-sweeps it, doesn't quite middle it, and it falls just short of deep midwicket, running in from the rope and diving forward and sprawling on his stomach
full-toss on off stump, angling into the batsman and tucking him up. Axar looks to swat it leg-side, can only inside-edge it into his back pad and send it rolling towards short fine leg
another slower ball outside off. Axar comes down the track, looking to carve over cover, and doesn't connect again
slower ball, may have been a wide because it seemed to be just outside the tramline outside off, but Bailey had moved across and he managed to flat-bat it and drag it down to long-off
another slower ball, wider this time, and Axar shuffles across and looks to launch down the ground, bounces towards long-on
slower ball just outside off. Axar spots it late, looks to chop it towards third man, can't connect
slower short ball, pulled towards deep backward square leg
down the track comes Bailey, spots some width on the slower one, and lifts it over extra cover, and long-off has no chance of cutting it off
very full close to off stump, Axar can't get any real power on his drive, straight towards cover
slower ball on off stump, comes forward and pushes it to cover
slower ball outside off, slapped towards deep point
full and wide, angling across Axar, and he goes for the drive and edges it thickly, wide of the keeper and it runs away to the third man boundary
length ball, turning sharply into Axar's pads. whips it towards short fine leg
good ball. Again he slid it wider outside off, and Patel swung, looking to go leg side, and missed. DK appealed for a caught behind, but no one else did
gone. Saw Miller coming down the track and slid it flat and wide outside off. Quick work from DK as well, collects and has the bails off before Miller can turn and try to regain his crease
down the track now, clipped towards backward square leg
goes on the back foot now, pushed through quicker, and punches into the covers

another. This one wasn't hit as straight or as cleanly. He was in the crease this time, and not quite to the pitch with his front-foot stride. Hit it to the right of Kohli at deep midwicket, and he positioned himself, dived to try and catch it, only managed to palm it over the boundary
down the track comes Miller, first ball, and that is a clean, clean strike, straight down the ground. The pavilion building is three storeys tall, and it went into the top tier
back of a length, angling in from wide of the crease, towards off stump. Tucked away towards midwicket
full on leg stump, and Bailey clips it towards short fine leg
and he's gone! That was another crisply hit pull, but it was in the air and he picked out the man at deep midwicket

smack. That was a short ball wide outside off. He knew Maxwell was trying to go across and hit leg-side, and he tried to prevent that, but Maxwell managed to play the pull and middle it perfectly, hitting towards square leg
slower ball outside off, and Vohra doesn't get hold of the attempted loft over long-off, ends up chipping it straight into the fielder's hands
length ball outside off. Maxwell leans back and clubs it towards long-on
shuffles a long way across, and flicks the low full-toss to deep square leg
shortish on off and middle, whipped towards deep backward square leg
much fuller now, and he can't get any elevation as he shapes to play a similar shot, ends up jabbing it along the ground, into the covers
full on leg stump, and that's a super shot from Vohra. Skips towards the leg side to make room, and brings his bat down nice and straight and lifts the ball over long-off
another slower ball, back of a length on off. Maxwell goes back and across and dabs it to third man
slower ball, angled across Maxwell, keeps low, and sneaks under his bat as he tries to whip it square on the leg side
down the track now, and tries to smack the wide length ball back down the ground. Inside-edges it instead, sends it rolling towards short fine leg
slower ball outside off, and Maxwell will feel he's missed out. Goes for the reverse-sweep, doesn't connect
full on middle and leg. Maxwell, back leg deep in his crease even before the bowler delivered, clips carefully to short midwicket
the wet patch comes into play. It's a length ball, fairly straight, and Vohra makes room to chip it over the covers. Timed it very well, but it stopped well short of the rope
fullish ball outside off, clears front leg and drives firmly to mid-on
starts with a full ball outside off, and Saha's innings comes to an end with another massive swipe. Doesn't connect cleanly this time, and skies it high to Mandeep at mid-on
length ball on off stump. Saha makes a lot of room and slaps it to cover
full, down the leg side, and Saha can't connect with the attempted pick-up shot

dropped. That was smacked back hard again, but this time flat, at chest height, and Aravind managed to get his hands up in time but barely had any time to close his fingers over the ball. It was hit so hard it ricocheted off them and raced to the straight boundary. Aravind is wincing now, and the physio is on the field.
fullish ball on middle stump, and Saha has dumped it back over the bowler's head, over the long-on boundary. He opened up his body entirely and swiped it with a diagonal swing of his bat
length ball angled across Saha, and he pokes at it with an angled bat and gets beaten
ooh, nearly chops it on. Stayed leg-side of the ball, a length ball on off stump, to stab it through point, and ends up inside-edging it past his leg stump to the fine leg boundary
short ball on leg stump, sits up at waist height and Saha swivels and swats it over square leg once again. One bounce, this time.
full-toss on off stump, pushed to mid-off for a quick single
wow. That's a regular length ball, heading towards the top of off stump, and he opens up his hips and swings across the line to clump it over the square leg boundary
low full-toss on the pads, and Saha swipes it away to the fine leg boundary
length ball on a tight off-stump line. Stays in the crease and bunts it into the covers with soft hands
back of a length outside off, Saha plays a checked punch towards mid-off
a bit of inswing, but it starts on leg stump and curls down the leg side as Saha fails to connect with a flick
length ball, a bit of width outside off stump, and Saha steers it away to the right of third man
full on off stump, driven down to long-off, and they finish with a single, and end up 23 short of their target
another slower ball on off stump. Sarfaraz makes room to hit over cover, ends up slicing it high in the air, straight to third man
another slower ball outside off, clubbed to long-on
back of a length slower ball outside off, sneaks under Wiese's bat as he aims a pull at it
fuller now, and this time he connects with the lap from outside off, but hits it straight to backward square leg
slower ball outside off, makes no contact as he tries to play the lap-scoop

he begins with a high full-toss, heading towards the right shoulder of the batsman. Takes his eyes off it as he half-fends, half-pulls, and it goes off the edge towards short third man. Slipped out of his hand, I guess
shorter now, on off stump, and he clears his front leg and flat-bats it to long-off
speared full and flat on off stump, slapped to sweeper cover
again it's flat and quick, but it's shorter, and angled into the batsman's body to cramp him for room. Goes for the pull, gets it high on the bat, and holes out to long-on
follows the batsman as Sarfaraz comes down the track, moving towards the leg side. Goes for the big hit, drags it in the air to the right of deep midwicket, drops well short of him
down the track and he fires it full, angling into the batsman. Jabbed towards square cover
sees him making room and bowls it flat and straight. Sarfaraz swipes it down to long-on
slower ball outside off, and Mandeep swings and misses, looking to carve over the off side

very full on middle stump, and DK tried to play a straight-bat, bottom-hand shovel to get under the ball and get elevation. He managed this, but not the distance, and the skier dropped gently into long-on's hands
low full-toss on middle stump, down on one knee to swing it away to deep midwicket
slower ball on middle stump, angling in and denying the batsman room. Pushed into the covers
banged in short, angling into the body. Swivels round and hooks towards long leg. Has to dive to complete the second, may have been interesting if the throw had hit direct
very full outside off. Makes swinging room and swipes it down to long-on
length ball angling into off stump, Mandeep plays the checked drive to long-off
full and flat on middle and leg, clipped into the vacant midwicket region, and the bowler sprints to field it
AB's gone! it's fired flat towards leg stump and AB went for the sweep, looking to hit over short fine leg, but he simply didn't middle it and popped a simple catch to the fielder, off the top-edge
fired down the leg side, swept to short fine leg
smack. Axar saw him premeditate the reverse-sweep and dragged his length back, but he still made good contact and found the backward point boundary
looks to sweep, goes off the pad to short third man
sees AB make room and follows him. He manages to hoick it away to the right of the deep square leg fielder and pick up a couple
sees him make room and bowls a slower ball outside off. Mandeep gets down on one knee and slaps it towards long-off
sees him coming down the pitch and bowls a bouncer wide outside off. Mandeep has to jump in the air to uppercut that, and doesn't hit too cleanly. Slows down near the third man boundary
slower ball again, shorter now, angling into the body. AB looks to pull, drags it squarer than he'd like, towards deep square leg

slower ball again, full on off stump, but this time de Villiers was in position early, back foot deep in his crease and front leg out of the way, and he waited on the ball and smacked it hard, between the non-striker and the stumps
slower ball again, on middle stump. Mandeep makes a bit of room and chips it over mid-off
slower ball, angling in towards off stump. Mandeep presses forward and pokes it into the covers to pick up a single

and he gets off the mark with a cracking boundary. It was on a length, giving him plenty of width, and he moved his front leg out of the way, got his head just about over the ball and cracked it to the cover boundary
bouncer and he's taken out Gayle! It was a well-directed ball, over Gayle's left shoulder. Not an easy place to pull from, and he only got a thin edge through to the keeper

I think Sandeep thought Gayle was looking to clear his front leg and fired it in full, looking to aim at the imagined place where his front foot would be, but he made no such movement, and it simply slid down the leg side
slower ball again, on a fullish length outside off, swings at it and doesn't connect too cleanly, rolls down to long-on
full slower ball outside off. Gayle is down on one knee to drag it to deep midwcket
full and wide again, and he slices it in the air, one bounce down to sweeper cover
full and wide. The idea was pretty good, because AB seemed to be looking to back away, but he just went an inch past the tramline outside off
another slower ball, wide outside off, AB drags his pull to deep midwicket
slower ball on off stump. Gayle makes a bit of room and flat-bats it to long-off
slower ball outside off, stands tall and flat-bats it past the diving short extra cover fielder, to the left of long-off
length ball, keeps it close to Gayle's body, and he opens up at the hips and swats it towards deep midwicket
fullish on middle and leg, driven towards long-on
back of a length, straight. Gayle tucks it off his hips through backward square leg
he's struck. It wasn't a great ball, a length ball wide outside off, but it didn't quite come on for the cover drive and Kohli's bottom hand took over, and he ended up chopping it onto his stumps
another slower ball, wider this time, and Kohli makes himself some additional room and lifts it over the leaping short extra cover fielder
slower ball, on middle and leg, and Kohli gets his front leg out of the way and hits through the line, clean as a whistle, and clears long-on easily
slower ball outside off, Kohli comes forward and pushes the ball through square-ish cover
length ball outside off, sits up for Kohli, who brings his strong bottom wrist into play to stand tall and whip it over mid-on
very full, follows Gayle and bowls at his feet, just outside leg. Gayle can't get too much contact on it as he tries to flick, and it dribbles into the leg side and he sprints a rare quick single
length ball outside off, and Kohli swings through the line, hits in the air, but doesn't connect too cleanly. Stops well short of the wide long-off boundary
slower ball on off stump. Gayle clears his front leg and swats it to deep square leg
very full on leg stump, and he shuffles across and clips to deep square leg
slower ball, very full on leg stump, clipped to midwicket
full outside off. Kohli took a step back in his crease to make some hitting room, but could only drill it straight to mid-off
starts with an excellent ball, angling away from Kohli, on a good length, and he pushes at it and misses

yorker, and that's a big shout for lbw. It swung in a touch and either hit the the inside edge and then the boot, or just the boot. It also ricocheted to slip, who appealed for a catch. They're going to the third umpire for this one. I think the umpire knows it's hit the bat, and is checking if it went straight off the bat and into foot. It wasn't. Bottom of the bat, and then the ground, and then Gayle's back foot.
again the straighter line, on leg stump. This time Gayle manages to get his front leg out of the way and swat it away to the square leg boundary
length ball, smacks Gayle on the pad and ricochets to short third man. He was looking to clear his front leg and hit over the leg side
boom. It was a fullish ball outside off, and Gayle stepped down the pitch, away from the line, and swung through the line to lift it high over long-off
length ball, tucking Gayle up for room, stands there and clubs it to mid-on
begins with a beauty that swerves away from Gayle outside off. He doesn't move his feet an inch and pokes at it with hands alone, makes no contact
